title: What Cave Home Networks Is
definition: Cave Home Networks: networks of modern cave homes.
description:
Cave Home Networks — Signature Edition: networks of modern cave homes. This is the JAH-original vision, designed from first principles and labeled as Signature speculation throughout.

The Signature network hulls program starts where public roadmaps stop. Where public research asks what is fundable, the Signature line asks what is buildable: excavated homes rethought, network logistics rebuilt, rock stability reimagined for the century ahead. t: The Signature Vision: Cave Home Networks
title: The Signature Vision: Cave Home Networks
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Cave Home Networks.
description:
The Signature vision of Cave Home Networks does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature network hulls program, charter one: master excavated homes at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale network logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate rock stability systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Cave Home Networks becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: 2030 — First network hulls districts certified: excavated homes assembl

description:
First network hulls districts certified: excavated homes assembly at half the time and carbon of legacy builds.

title: Readiness Estimator: Cave Home Networks
definition: Estimates Cave Home Networks readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Cave Home Networks components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a network hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Cave Home Networks Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Cave Home Networks operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Cave Home Networks installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 16097 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where excavated homes monitoring, network logistics redundancy, or rock stability maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Cave Home Networks Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Cave Home Networks: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Cave Home Networks — networks of modern cave homes.

Phase 1 — Prove (excavated homes): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (network logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (rock stability): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (climate control): network hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and hillsides-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
